title: When AI Sits Between a Job and a Person
japanese_title: AIが仕事と人の間に立つとき
minimal_fix_edits: I know about another applicant. He said AI scored his reliability and honesty. He had no way to say no to the system. He also had no way to challenge the result.
I also judge résumés written by AI. Is this a useful skill?
Each week, I look at the hiring dashboard. It shows time, cost, and the people we still need.
